name: WfExS TES template SAREK complete v4
description: Complete TES template v4 for executing Sarek test full.

command: export XDG_CACHE_HOME="/workflows/${__analysis__}/side_caches" ; export WFEXS_CONFIG_FILE="/workflows/${__analysis__}/funnel_tre_wfexs_restricted.yaml" ; export WRROC="/workflows/${__analysis__}/wrroc.zip" ; export ENCRYPTED_PATH="/inputs/${TRE_INPUT_ID}" ; export DECRYPTED_PATH="/shared/datasets/${TRE_INPUT_ID}" ; export _input_1_fastq_1="${DECRYPTED_PATH}/$input_1_fastq_1" ; export _input_1_fastq_2="${DECRYPTED_PATH}/$input_1_fastq_2" ; export _input_2_fastq_1="${DECRYPTED_PATH}/$input_2_fastq_1" ; export _input_2_fastq_2="${DECRYPTED_PATH}/$input_2_fastq_2" ; mkdir -p /outputs/analysis_outputs /outputs/tes_logs "${DECRYPTED_PATH}" /shared/.parameters ; chmod go+w /outputs/tes_logs ; chmod ugo+rwxt /tmp ; echo "$TRE_INPUT_CREDENTIALS" > /shared/.parameters/.credentials  ; declare +x PWD OLDPWD HOME HOSTNAME PATH LS_COLORS SHLVL ; declare -x > /shared/.parameters/env

source /shared/.parameters/env ; exec > /shared/config.wfex.stage ; echo 'params:' && echo '  input:' && echo '    c-l-a-s-s: ContentWithURIs' && echo '    preferred-name: input.csv' && echo '    clonable: false' && echo '    cacheable: false' && echo '    url: file:///shared/tab_input.txt' && echo '    tabular:' && echo '      uri-columns:' && echo '        - 5' && echo '        - 6' && echo '      column-sep: ","' && echo '      header-rows: 1'

source /shared/.parameters/env ; gocryptfs -nosyslog -ro -q -extpass 'cat /shared/.parameters/.credentials' "${ENCRYPTED_PATH}" "${DECRYPTED_PATH}" >> /outputs/tes_logs/gocryptfs-logs.txt 2>&1 ; declare +x AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_ENDPOINT_URL AWS_REGION  AWS_S3_ENDPOINT AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ENDPOINT MINIO_SECRET_KEY ; WfExS-backend import -R "$WRROC" -s --strict-reproducibility --reproducibility-level 3 --no-disclosable-default --no-clonable-default -W /shared/config.wfex.stage --save-workdir-id /shared/workdir_id_stage.txt

source /shared/.parameters/env ; gocryptfs -nosyslog -ro -q -extpass 'cat /shared/.parameters/.credentials' "${ENCRYPTED_PATH}" "${DECRYPTED_PATH}" >> /outputs/tes_logs/gocryptfs-logs.txt 2>&1 ; declare +x AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_ENDPOINT_URL AWS_REGION  AWS_S3_ENDPOINT AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ENDPOINT MINIO_SECRET_KEY ; WfExS-backend staged-workdir offline-exec /shared/workdir_id_stage.txt

source /shared/.parameters/env ; gocryptfs -nosyslog -ro -q -extpass 'cat /shared/.parameters/.credentials' "${ENCRYPTED_PATH}" "${DECRYPTED_PATH}" >> /outputs/tes_logs/gocryptfs-logs.txt 2>&1 ; declare +x AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_ENDPOINT_URL AWS_REGION  AWS_S3_ENDPOINT AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ENDPOINT MINIO_SECRET_KEY ; WfExS-backend staged-workdir --workflow --containers create-prov-crate /shared/workdir_id_stage.txt /outputs/output_wrroc.zip

source /shared/.parameters/env ; gocryptfs -nosyslog -ro -q -extpass 'cat /shared/.parameters/.credentials' "${ENCRYPTED_PATH}" "${DECRYPTED_PATH}" >> /outputs/tes_logs/gocryptfs-logs.txt 2>&1 ; declare +x AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_ENDPOINT_URL AWS_REGION  AWS_S3_ENDPOINT AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ACCESS_KEY MINIO_ENDPOINT MINIO_SECRET_KEY ; WfExS-backend staged-workdir shell /shared/workdir_id_stage.txt -- bash -c "cp -dpLr outputs/* meta/outputs/*/stats /outputs/analysis_outputs"
